name: Verapamil
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Higher ivabradine exposure; worse bradycardia and conduction disturbances (label).
Additive effects on heart rate, AV conduction and contractility; complete heart block reported (label).
key_interactions.action: Use only with caution and close monitoring.

key_interactions.effect: Digoxin levels up 50 to 75% in the first week; toxicity (label).
key_interactions.action: Consider reducing the digoxin dose; monitor digoxin levels.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Simvastatin, lovastatin and other CYP3A4 statins
key_interactions.effect: Higher statin levels; myopathy and rhabdomyolysis (label).
key_interactions.action: Limit simvastatin to 10 mg and lovastatin to 40 mg daily; lower doses of other CYP3A4 statins may be needed.

key_interactions.effect: Inhibitors raise and inducers lower verapamil levels (label).

key_interactions.action: Do not give disopyramide within 48 hours before or 24 hours after verapamil.
